prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Gonger, drowned North Frisian revenant bringing news of death.
ANATOMY: ONE drowned adult male sailor revenant, one head, TWO eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs, fully clothed in soaked rough dark wool coat, trousers and heavy pulled-up sea boots FULL OF WATER [gonger-c03,gonger-c10,gonger-c11]. Pallid human face, no decay, wounds, glowing eyes or invented undead anatomy. Salt water runs abundantly from boots and sleeves, wet hair plastered to brow.
MOMENT: Lean over a wooden sleeping alcove toward viewer and extend one dripping hand directly onto a small oil-lamp flame to PUT IT OUT; flame is visibly being smothered by his palm with last orange ember and thin black smoke. Other arm braces doorway. Eyes intensely solemn, mouth closed. Heavy boots leave a long unmistakable trail and puddle of salt water across dry floor. No sleeping person shown.
POWER: Drowned revenant puts out light by hand, visits relatives and leaves salt water [gonger-c03,gonger-c10,gonger-c11]. No invented magic; impossible bare-hand extinguishing and continuous seawater footprint are source manifestations.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; close low bedside confrontation, dripping hand/lamp/face occupy square; spectral solemnity rather than ordinary standing sailor.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low amber moon or lamp, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light, ordinary water spray or dust as appropriate.
SURFACE: tactile wet skin, coarse cloth, scales, hair, old wood and stone; premium painterly brushwork.
SETTING: North Frisian house of kin at night [gonger-c03,gonger-c11].
MOOD: imposing and active, never cute, calm or decorative. Sacred and benevolent figures remain dignified and protective.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native inspected: pallid drenched sailor revenant leans into bedside view, one bare hand directly smothers flame without injury, other braces door; water streams from heavy boots and coat across floor. Two arms, one visible boot and other leg naturally behind. Source c11 hand-extinguishing and saltwater manifestation, solemn c09 disposition rather than invented monster face. Native and 200px strong intrusive close encounter; no text/aura. All Sangar criteria pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + reaching-hand and face crops. A drowned revenant sailor (gonger-c01/c03/c04): a gaunt, pallid, water-soaked man with hollow sorrowful eyes — unmistakably a Wiedergänger, not a living passerby. Two arms — the right hand (five digits confirmed, no extra) held over an oil-lamp flame that is going out with a thread of rising smoke, the left braced on the doorframe. He wears the same soaked clothes and heavy water-filled boots he drowned in, and a continuous trail of saltwater runs across the floor from the open moonlit door (gonger-c03/c11). Night interior of a North Frisian house; thatched house and full moon outside. Uncanny supernatural dread rather than an ordinary man; no gore, aura, text or borrowed design.
